event.description: Event name to match (e.g. '$pageview', '$autocapture', or a custom event name).

properties.description: Event or person property filters. Each item should have 'key' (string), 'value' (string, number, boolean, or array), optional 'operator' (exact, is_not, is_set, is_not_set, icontains, not_icontains, regex, not_regex, gt, gte, lt, lte), and optional 'type' (event, person).

selector.description: CSS selector to match the target element (e.g. 'div > button.cta').

text_matching.description:
How to match the text value. Defaults to exact.

* `contains` - contains
* `regex` - regex
* `exact` - exact

href_matching.description:
How to match the href value. Defaults to exact.

* `contains` - contains
* `regex` - regex
* `exact` - exact

url_matching.description:
How to match the URL value. Defaults to contains.

* `contains` - contains
* `regex` - regex
* `exact` - exact
